Abjuration Savant: The gold and time to copy an Abjuration spell into your spellbook is halved.
Acolyte Of Nature: You learn one druid cantrip and gain proficiency in Animal Handling, Nature, or Survival.
Additional Fighting Style: You can choose a second Fighting Style option from the fighter class list.
Additional Magical Secrets: Learn two spells from any class list; they count as bard spells for you.
Alter Memories: When you use Cutting Words or other inspiration on a creature, you can alter the target's memory of the event up to 1 hour later.
Arcane Charge: When you use Action Surge, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
Arcane Ward: Create a magical ward that absorbs damage equal to twice your wizard level + your Intelligence modifier.
Aspect Of The Beast: Gain a totem-specific benefit while raging: Bear (carrying capacity doubles, advantage on Strength checks), Eagle (eyes can see up to 1 mile, dim light counts as bright, can spot hidden creatures), or Wolf (can track while traveling at fast pace, can hide while trailing, can communicate with wolves).
Assassinate: You have advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn in combat yet, and hits against surprised creatures are critical hits.
Aura Of Devotion: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet cannot be charmed while you are conscious.
Aura Of Warding: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet have resistance to damage from spells.
Avatar Of Battle: You gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons.
Avenging Angel: For 1 minute, you gain a flying speed of 60 feet, an aura of fear that frightens enemies, and deal extra damage equal to your Charisma modifier when you hit with a weapon.
Awakened Mind: You can telepathically speak to any creature within 30 feet that shares a language with you.
Battle Magic: After casting a bard spell with your action, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.
Beguiling Defenses: You are immune to being charmed, and when a creature tries to charm you, it takes psychic damage equal to 5 times your Charisma modifier.
Bend Luck: When a creature you can see makes an attack roll or ability check, you can use your reaction and spend 2 sorcery points to add or subtract 1d4 from the roll.
Benign Transposition: As an action, teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, or swap places with a willing Small or Medium creature.
Bestial Fury: Your animal companion can make two attacks when you command it to take the Attack action.
Blessed Healer: When you heal another creature with a spell, you also regain hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.
Blessing Of The Trickster: Use your Channel Divinity to grant a creature advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for 1 hour.
Blessings Of Knowledge: You learn two languages and gain expertise-like double proficiency in two knowledge skills of your choice.
Bonus Cantrip Land: You learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice.
Bonus Cantrip Light: You learn the Light cantrip if you do not already know it.
Bonus Proficiencies: You gain additional proficiencies from your college or subclass choice.
Bonus Proficiencies Assassin: You gain proficiency with the disguise kit and the poisoner's kit.
Bonus Proficiencies Tempest: You gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.
Bonus Proficiencies War: You gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.
Bonus Proficiency Life: You gain proficiency with heavy armor.
Bonus Proficiency Nature: You gain proficiency with heavy armor.
Channel Divinity Abjure Enemy: Present your holy symbol to frighten one creature within 60 feet. On a failed save it is frightened for 1 minute (speed 0), on a success its speed is halved for 1 minute.
Channel Divinity Charm Animals And Plant: Present your holy symbol to charm beasts and plants within 30 feet for 1 minute or until they take damage.
Channel Divinity Cloak Of Shadows: Use your Channel Divinity to become invisible for 1 minute. The effect ends if you attack or cast a spell.
Channel Divinity Destructive Wrath: When you roll lightning or thunder damage, use your Channel Divinity to deal maximum damage instead of rolling.
Channel Divinity Guided Strike: Use your Channel Divinity to add a +10 bonus to an attack roll you make.
Channel Divinity Invoke Duplicity: Create an illusory duplicate of yourself within 30 feet that lasts for 1 minute. You can cast spells as if you were in the duplicate's space.
Channel Divinity Knowledge Of The Ages: Use Channel Divinity to gain proficiency with one skill or tool for 10 minutes.
Channel Divinity Natures Wrath: Use an action to cause spectral vines to restrain a creature within 10 feet. It repeats saves at end of each turn to break free.
Channel Divinity Preserve Life: Use Channel Divinity to restore up to 5 × your cleric level hit points among creatures within 30 feet, but not undead or constructs.
Channel Divinity Radiance Of The Dawn: Dispel magical darkness within 30 feet and deal 2d10 + cleric level radiant damage to hostile creatures in range.
Channel Divinity Sacred Weapon: Imbue one weapon you hold with positive energy for 1 minute, adding your Charisma modifier to attack rolls and making it magical.
Channel Divinity Turn The Faithless: Present your holy symbol to turn fey or fiends within 30 feet for 1 minute or until they take damage.
Channel Divinity Turn The Unholy: Present your holy symbol to turn fiends and undead within 30 feet for 1 minute or until they take damage.
Channel Divinity Vow Of Enmity: Utter a vow of enmity as a bonus action against a creature within 10 feet, gaining advantage on attack rolls against it for 1 minute.
Channel Divinity War Gods Blessing: When a creature within 30 feet makes an attack roll, use your reaction to grant a +10 bonus to the roll.
Circle Forms: You can use Wild Shape to transform into beasts up to CR 1 (or CR 1/2 at 6th, CR 1 at 8th, CR 2 at 9th, CR 3 at 12th, CR 4 at 15th, CR 5 at 18th).
Circle Spells Land: Your mystical connection to the land infuses you with the ability to cast certain spells. At 3rd, 5th, 7th, and 9th level you gain access to circle spells connected to the land where you became a druid. Choose that land — Arctic, Coast, Desert, Forest, Grassland, Mountain, Swamp, or Underdark — and consult the associated list of spells. Once you gain access to a circle spell, you always have it prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day.
Cloak Of Shadows: At 11th level, you can use an action to become invisible for 1 minute while in dim light or darkness.
Combat Inspiration: Allies can use your Bardic Inspiration to boost weapon damage or improve AC against one attack.
Combat Superiority: You learn maneuvers fueled by superiority dice. You have four superiority dice (d8s) and learn three maneuvers at 3rd level. You learn two additional maneuvers at 7th, 10th, and 15th level, and gain another superiority die at 7th and 15th level. You regain all superiority dice after a short or long rest. Maneuver save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength or Dexterity modifier. Only one maneuver per attack.
Combat Wild Shape: As a bonus action, you can Wild Shape into a beast with a CR up to 1 (ignoring CR limits for Moon circle forms).
Command Undead: Use an action to command one undead within 60 feet. If it fails a Charisma save, it becomes friendly and obeys your commands.
Conjuration Savant: The gold and time to copy a Conjuration spell into your spellbook is halved.
Controlled Chaos: When you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, roll twice and choose which effect happens.
Corona Of Light: You emit bright light in a 60-foot radius and dim light for another 60 feet. Enemies in the bright light have disadvantage on saves against your fire or radiant spells.
Create Thrall: You can cast dominate monster on a humanoid once. While dominated, the target takes psychic damage if it tries to harm you.
Cutting Words: Use Bardic Inspiration as a reaction to reduce an enemy attack roll, ability check, or damage roll by the inspiration die roll.
Dampen Elements: When a creature within 30 feet takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, you can use your reaction to grant resistance to that damage.
Dark Delirium: As an action, you can create a 30-foot cube of magical darkness that lasts 1 minute. Creatures of your choice in it are frightened.
Dark Ones Blessing: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + your warlock level.
Dark Ones Own Luck: You can add a d10 to one ability check or saving throw. You can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.
Death Strike: When you attack a surprised creature, it must make a Constitution save or take double damage from your attack.
Defensive Tactics: At 7th level you gain a defensive feature based on your chosen hunter archetype (Escape the Horde, Multiattack Defense, or Steel Will).
Disciple Of Life: Your healing spells restore additional hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.
Disciple Of The Elements: You learn elemental disciplines that allow you to spend ki points to cast spells or create supernatural effects.
Divination Savant: The gold and time to copy a Divination spell into your spellbook is halved.
Divine Strike Life: Once on each of your turns when you hit with a weapon, deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage (2d8 at 14th level).
Divine Strike Nature: Once on each of your turns when you hit with a weapon, deal an extra 1d8 cold, fire, or lightning damage (2d8 at 14th level).
Divine Strike Tempest: Once on each of your turns when you hit with a weapon, deal an extra 1d8 thunder damage (2d8 at 14th level).
Divine Strike Trickery: Once on each of your turns when you hit with a weapon, deal an extra 1d8 poison damage (2d8 at 14th level), and the attack is made with advantage if you are invisible.
Divine Strike War: Once on each of your turns when you hit with a weapon, deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage (2d8 at 14th level).
Domain Spells Knowledge: You gain Knowledge Domain spells that are always prepared at the listed cleric levels (command, identify, augury, suggestion, etc.).
Domain Spells Life: You gain Life Domain spells that are always prepared at the listed cleric levels (bless, cure wounds, spiritual weapon, beacon of hope, etc.).
Domain Spells Light: You gain Light Domain spells that are always prepared at the listed cleric levels (burning hands, faerie fire, flaming sphere, etc.).
Domain Spells Nature: You gain Nature Domain spells that are always prepared at the listed cleric levels (animal friendship, speak with animals, etc.).
Domain Spells Tempest: You gain Tempest Domain spells that are always prepared at the listed cleric levels (fog cloud, thunderwave, gust of wind, etc.).
Domain Spells Trickery: You gain Trickery Domain spells that are always prepared at the listed cleric levels (charm person, mirror image, pass without trace, etc.).
Domain Spells War: You gain War Domain spells that are always prepared at the listed cleric levels (divine favor, shield of faith, magic weapon, etc.).
Draconic Presence: Spend 5 sorcery points to create an aura of awe or fear in a 60-foot radius for 1 minute. Hostile creatures that start their turn in it must save or be charmed/frightened.
Draconic Resilience: Your hit point maximum increases by 1 per sorcerer level, and your base AC becomes 13 + Dexterity modifier while unarmored.
Dragon Wings: Sprout dragon wings as a bonus action, gaining a flying speed equal to your current speed. Dismiss them as a bonus action.
Durable Summons: Any creature you summon or create with a conjuration spell gains 30 temporary hit points.
Elder Champion: For 1 minute, you gain a flying speed of 50 feet and regains 10 hit points at the start of each of your turns. You can cast a single-target spell on two targets instead of one.
Eldritch Strike: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, it has disadvantage on the next saving throw against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.
Elemental Affinity: When you cast a spell that deals damage matching your draconic ancestry type, add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll. You can also spend 1 sorcery point to gain resistance to that damage type for 1 hour.
Elemental Attunement 11: At 11th level you learn an 11th-level elemental discipline, allowing you to spend ki points for spell-like effects such as stoneskin or fireball.
Elemental Attunement 17: At 17th level you learn a 17th-level elemental discipline, allowing you to spend 6 ki points to cast cone of cold or similar effects.
Elemental Attunement 6: At 6th level you learn a 6th-level elemental discipline, allowing you to spend ki points for effects such as hold person or shatter.
Elemental Wild Shape: You can expend two uses of Wild Shape to transform into an air, earth, fire, or water elemental.
Empowered Evocation: You add your Intelligence modifier to the damage of any wizard evocation spell you cast.
Enchantment Savant: The gold and time to copy an Enchantment spell into your spellbook is halved.
Entropic Ward: When an enemy makes an attack roll against you, you can impose disadvantage. If the attack misses, you gain advantage on your next attack roll against that creature.
Evocation Savant: The gold and time to copy an Evocation spell into your spellbook is halved.
Exceptional Training: Your animal companion can take the Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help action on its own without you commanding it.
Expert Divination: When you cast a divination spell of 2nd level or higher, you regain one expended spell slot of a level lower than the spell you cast.
Extra Attack Valor: You can attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action on your turn.
Fast Hands: Use your Cunning Action bonus action to make Sleight of Hand checks, disarm traps, open locks, or take the Use an Object action.
Fey Presence: As an action, cause each creature in a 10-foot cube from you to make a Wisdom save or be charmed or frightened until the end of your next turn.
Fiendish Resilience: When you finish a short or long rest, choose one damage type. You gain resistance to that damage type until you choose a different one.
Fighting Style Archery: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls with ranged weapons.
Fighting Style Defense: While wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.
Fighting Style Dueling: When wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.
Fighting Style Great Weapon Fighting: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for a melee attack with a two-handed or versatile weapon, reroll and use the new roll.
Fighting Style Protection: When a creature you can see attacks a target within 5 feet of you, use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll. You must be wielding a shield.
Fighting Style Two Weapon Fighting: When two-weapon fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.
Focused Conjuration: While concentrating on a conjuration spell, your concentration cannot be broken by taking damage.
Frenzy: While raging, you can make a single melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each turn; you gain one level of exhaustion when the rage ends.
Greater Portent: Roll three d20s for your Portent feature instead of two.
Grim Harvest: When you kill a creature with a spell of 1st level or higher, regain hit points equal to twice the spell level (or three times if necromancy).
Holy Nimbus: As an action, you emanate an aura of sunlight. For 1 minute, bright light shines from you, and enemies within 30 feet take 10 radiant damage when they hit you with a melee attack.
Hunters Prey: At 3rd level you gain a combat feature based on your hunter choice (Colossus Slayer, Giant Killer, or Horde Breaker).
Hurl Through Hell: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can send it to a lower plane for a moment. It disappears and takes 10d10 psychic damage, then reappears.
Hypnotic Gaze: Charm one creature within 5 feet. While charmed, its speed drops to 0 and it is incapacitated. You can maintain this on subsequent turns with your action.
Illusion Savant: The gold and time to copy an Illusion spell into your spellbook is halved.
Illusory Reality: When you cast an illusion spell of 1st level or higher, you can choose one nonmagical object in the illusion and make it real for 1 minute.
Illusory Self: When a creature attacks you, use your reaction to create an illusory duplicate. The attack automatically misses, then the illusion dissipates.
Impostor: You can mimic another creature's speech, handwriting, and behavior. You have advantage on Deception checks to pass as someone else.
Improved Abjuration: When you cast an abjuration spell that requires an ability check as part of casting it (such as dispel magic or counterspell), add your proficiency bonus to the ability check.
Improved Combat Superiority: Your superiority dice become d10s at 10th level and d12s at 18th level.
Improved Critical: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.
Improved Duplicity: Your illusory duplicate can now cast spells and your concentration on its spell can be maintained from the duplicate's space.
Improved Flare: You can use your Warding Flare feature when a creature within 30 feet of you attacks an ally, not just yourself.
Improved Minor Illusion: You learn the minor illusion cantrip if you don't know it, and you can create both a sound and an image with a single casting.
Improved War Magic: After you cast a cantrip with your action, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.
Infiltration Expertise: You can create false identities for yourself. You master the disguise kit and forgery kit, and you can unerringly mimic another person's speech patterns and handwriting.
Instinctive Charm: When an enemy attacks you, use your reaction to divert the attack to another creature within 30 feet. The attacker must make a Wisdom save or target the other creature.
Intimidating Presence: As an action, frighten one creature within 30 feet. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.
Inured To Undead: You have resistance to necrotic damage, and your hit point maximum cannot be reduced.
Know Your Enemy: If you spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with another creature outside combat, you can learn certain information about its capabilities compared to your own. The DM tells you if the creature is your equal, superior, or inferior in regard to two of the following characteristics of your choice: Strength score, Dexterity score, Constitution score, Armor Class, Current hit points, Total class levels (if any), or Fighter class levels (if any).
Lands Stride: Moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs you no extra movement. You can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed or taking damage.
Mage Hand Legerdemain: Your mage hand is invisible and can perform Sleight of Hand checks, use thieves' tools, or stow/retrieve objects from containers worn or carried by others.
Magical Ambush: If you are hidden when you cast a spell on a creature, it has disadvantage on its first saving throw against the spell.
Malleable Illusions: When you cast an illusion spell with duration 1 minute or longer, you can use your action to change the nature of the illusion.
Master Of Nature: You can cast command or speak with animals at will as a 1st-level spell.
Master Transmuter: You gain the ability to create a transmuter's stone with one of several permanent effects: +2 AC, +2 to saving throws, +10 speed, darkvision, or resistance to a chosen damage type.
Metamagic Careful Spell: Spend 1 sorcery point when casting a spell that forces saves; protect a number of creatures up to your Charisma modifier who automatically succeed on their saves.
Metamagic Distant Spell: Spend 1 sorcery point to double a spell's range, or make a touch spell range 30 feet.
Metamagic Empowered Spell: Spend 1 sorcery point to reroll a number of damage dice equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum one) when you roll damage for a spell.
Metamagic Extended Spell: Spend 1 sorcery point when casting a spell with a duration of 1 minute or longer to double its duration.
Metamagic Heightened Spell: Spend 3 sorcery points to give one target of a spell disadvantage on its first saving throw.
Metamagic Quickened Spell: Spend 2 sorcery points to change a spell's casting time from 1 action to 1 bonus action.
Metamagic Subtle Spell: Spend 1 sorcery point to cast a spell without any somatic or verbal components.
Metamagic Twinned Spell: Spend sorcery points equal to the spell's level (1 for cantrips) to target a second creature with a single-target spell.
Mindless Rage: While raging, you cannot be charmed or frightened; if already charmed or frightened, the effect is suspended for the rage.
Minor Alchemy: Spend 10 minutes working on a nonmagical, nonliving object to transform it from one material into another (wood→silver, iron→copper, etc.) for 1 hour.
Minor Conjuration: Use your action to conjure a nonmagical object no larger than 3 feet per side and 10 pounds in your hand for 1 hour.
Misty Escape: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to become invisible and teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
Multiattack: At 11th level, you can make multiple attacks against creatures. You choose Volley (ranged attack on multiple targets in a 10-foot radius) or Whirlwind Attack (melee attack on multiple creatures within 5 feet).
Natural Recovery: During a short rest, you can recover expended spell slots with a combined level equal to or less than half your druid level (rounded up, max 5th level).
Natures Sanctuary: When a beast or plant tries to attack you, it must make a Wisdom save or be forced to target another creature instead.
Natures Ward: You cannot be charmed or frightened by elementals or fey, and you are immune to poison and disease.
Necromancy Savant: The gold and time to copy a Necromancy spell into your spellbook is halved.
Oath Spells Ancients: You gain oath spells that are always prepared at the listed paladin levels (ensnaring strike, speak with animals, moonbeam, misty step, etc.).
Oath Spells Devotion: You gain oath spells that are always prepared at the listed paladin levels (protection from evil, sanctuary, lesser restoration, zone of truth, etc.).
Oath Spells Vengeance: You gain oath spells that are always prepared at the listed paladin levels (bane, hunter's mark, hold person, misty step, haste, etc.).
Open Hand Technique: When you hit with a Flurry of Blows, you can choose to knock the target prone, push it 15 feet, or prevent it from taking reactions for 1 round.
Opportunist: When a creature provokes an opportunity attack from an ally, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against that creature.
Overchannel: When you cast a wizard spell of 5th level or lower that deals damage, you can deal maximum damage. Using it again before a long rest deals necrotic damage to you.
Pact Boon Blade: You can create a pact weapon in your empty hand or bind a magic weapon to your pact. You are proficient with it and it counts as magical.
Pact Boon Chain: You gain a familiar (imp, pseudodragon, sprite, or quasit). You can also use the Attack action to let your familiar attack once.
Pact Boon Tome: You gain a Book of Shadows with three cantrips from any class's spell list. These cantrips count as warlock spells for you.
Peerless Skill: When making an ability check, you can add a Bardic Inspiration die after seeing the roll.
Portent: When you finish a long rest, roll two d20s and record them. You can replace any attack roll, save, or ability check by you or a creature you can see with one of these rolls.
Potent Cantrip: When a creature succeeds on a save against your cantrip, it still takes half damage (if it deals damage) or suffers the effect (if no damage).
Potent Spellcasting: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your cleric cantrips.
Potent Spellcasting Light: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your cleric cantrips.
Primal Strike: Your attacks in beast form count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity.
Projected Ward: When a creature within 30 feet takes damage, you can use your reaction to have your Arcane Ward take the damage instead (minimum 0).
Purity Of Spirit: You are immune to disease and poison, and you have resistance to poison damage.
Quivering Palm: Spend 3 ki points when you hit with an unarmed strike. The target then must make a Constitution save or be reduced to 0 hit points (or take 10d10 necrotic on success).
Rangers Companion: You gain a beast companion that accompanies you and follows your commands during combat.
Read Thoughts: Use Channel Divinity to read a creature's surface thoughts for 1 minute, ending with the ability to cast suggestion on it without expending a spell slot.
Relenless Avenger: When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, you can move up to half your speed immediately without provoking opportunity attacks.
Relentless: When you roll initiative and have no superiority dice remaining, you regain 1 superiority die.
Remarkable Athlete: Add half your proficiency bonus (rounded up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check that doesn't already use proficiency. Your long jump distance also increases.
Retaliation: When a creature within 5 feet damages you, use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it.
Sculpt Spells: When you cast an evocation spell that affects other creatures, you can choose a number of creatures equal to 1 + the spell's level who automatically succeed on their saves and take no damage.
Second Story Work: Climbing no longer costs extra movement, and your running jump distance increases by your Dexterity modifier in feet.
Shadow Arts: Spend 2 ki points to cast darkness, darkvision, pass without trace, or silence as an action, without material components. You also gain the minor illusion cantrip.
Shadow Step: While in dim light or darkness, teleport up to 60 feet as a bonus action to another spot in dim light or darkness. You have advantage on the first melee attack you make before the end of the turn.
Shapechanger: You can cast polymorph on yourself at will, without expending a spell slot.
Share Spells: When you cast a spell with a range of self, you can also affect your animal companion with it.
Soul Of Vengeance: When a creature under your Vow of Enmity makes an attack, you can use your reaction to make a weapon attack against it.
Spell Bombardment: When you roll damage for a warlock spell and roll the highest possible number on any die, you can roll that die again and add it to the damage.
Spell Resistance: You have advantage on saving throws against spells and resistance to damage from spells.
Spell Thief: When a creature casts a spell targeting you, you can use your reaction to force the creature to save. On a failure, the spell fails and you learn it, casting it at its lowest level.
Spellcasting Arcane Trickster: This subclass grants third-caster spellcasting progression using the wizard spell list, focused on enchantment and illusion spells.
Spellcasting Eldritch Knight: This subclass grants third-caster spellcasting progression using the wizard spell list, focused on abjuration and evocation spells.
Spirit Seeker: You can cast beast sense and speak with animals as rituals.
Spirit Walker: You can cast commune with nature as a ritual.
Split Enchantment: When you cast an enchantment spell of 1st level or higher that targets only one creature, you can target a second creature as well.
Stormborn: You gain a flying speed equal to your current speed while outdoors.
Student Of War: You gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.
Superior Critical: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.
Superior Hunters Defense: At 15th level you gain a powerful defensive feature based on your hunter choice (Evasion, Uncanny Dodge, or Stand Against the Tide).
Supreme Healing: When you roll dice to restore hit points with a spell, use the highest number possible on each die.
Supreme Sneak: You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks if you move no more than half your speed on the same turn.
Survivor: At the start of each of your turns, regain hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if you have no more than half your hit points left.
Thiefs Reflexes: You can take two turns during the first round of any combat. Your first turn is at normal initiative, your second at initiative minus 10.
Third Eye: You can use your action to gain one of the following benefits until you rest: darkvision 60ft, ethereal sight, read any language, or see invisible creatures within 10ft.
Thought Shield: Your thoughts cannot be read by telepathy or other means unless you allow it. You also have resistance to psychic damage, and any creature dealing psychic damage to you takes the same amount.
Thousand Forms: You can cast alter self at will.
Thunderbolt Strike: When you deal lightning damage to a Large or smaller creature, you can also push it up to 10 feet away.
Tides Of Chaos: Gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw once per long rest. The DM can trigger a Wild Magic Surge to let you use it again.
Totem Spirit: At 3rd level, choose a totem spirit (bear, eagle, or wolf). While raging, you gain a benefit: Bear (resistance to all damage except psychic), Eagle (bonus action Dash, enemies have disadvantage on opportunity attacks), or Wolf (allies have advantage on melee attacks against enemies within 5 feet of you).
Totemic Attunement: At 14th level, while raging, you gain a powerful benefit based on your totem: Bear (taunt enemies within 5 feet), Eagle (fly), or Wolf (knock enemies prone on hit).
Tranquility: At the end of a long rest, you gain the effect of a sanctuary spell against creatures of your choice until the start of your next long rest.
Transmutation Savant: The gold and time to copy a Transmutation spell into your spellbook is halved.
Transmuters Stone: Create a transmuter's stone that grants one of: darkvision 60ft, +10 speed, proficiency in Constitution saves, or resistance to acid/cold/fire/lightning/thunder damage.
Undead Thralls: When you cast animate dead, you create one additional undead. Undead you create with necromancy spells gain bonus hit points equal to your wizard level and add your proficiency bonus to weapon damage.
Undying Sentinel: When you are reduced to 0 hit points, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.
Use Magic Device: Ignore all class, race, and level requirements on the use of magic items.
Versatile Trickster: You can use your mage hand to distract a creature as a bonus action, giving you advantage on attack rolls against it until the end of the turn.
Visions Of The Past: Meditate on an object for 1 minute to see visions of its previous owner. In an area, you see recent events. Usable once per short or long rest.
War Magic: When you use your action to cast a cantrip, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.
War Priest: When you take the Attack action, you can make one extra attack as a bonus action a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.
Warding Flare: Use your reaction to impose disadvantage on an attacker within 30 feet that you can see.
Weapon Bond: You can bond with up to two weapons by performing a ritual over them for 1 hour. If you are holding a bonded weapon, you can summon it to your hand as a bonus action.
Wholeness Of Body: As an action, you regain hit points equal to three times your monk level. You can't use this again until you finish a long rest.
Wild Magic Surge: After casting a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, the DM can have you roll a d20. On a 1, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table for a random effect.
Wrath Of The Storm: When you are hit by an attack, use your reaction to deal 2d8 lightning or thunder damage to the attacker; it also takes half damage on a successful Dexterity save.
